\]

title: Persistence exponents of multiply integrated Brownian motion
statement:
Let $B$ be a standard Brownian motion and define multiply integrated Brownian motion by
\[
A^{(1)}_t:=\int_0^t B_s\,ds,\qquad A^{(d)}_t:=\int_0^t A^{(d-1)}_s\,ds.
\]
These processes have polynomial persistence-probability decay with persistence exponent $\theta_d$. The only known exponent is $\theta_1=1/4$. Compute $\theta_d$ for $d\ge 2$.
